controls.name: C-21d
controls.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE host.name == "db-1" AND @timestamp >= "2026-07-06T20:02:30.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-06T21:02:30.000Z"
        AND process.name == "sshd"
| STATS count = COUNT(*), first_seen = MIN(@timestamp), last_seen = MAX(@timestamp) BY event.action, user.name, source.ip
| SORT count DESC
| LIMIT 20
